candidate: H52a robust eight-plane binary global-frame DCT-carrier capacity ceiling

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H51 proves learned global orientations help and the second frame adds capacity, but two multi-bit frames fit PC1 while leaving PC2-PC16 near coordinate chance. Reallocate frame bits to eight independent binary orientations and fit a weak-PC-balanced objective.

scientific_question: Can eight globally shared learned binary frames plus node-addressed fast DCT carriers and 0.390625% continuous local coordinates cover all top-16 directions of all six 239-state MLP paths under one percent deployment bytes?

frozen_inventory.pca_centering: independent mean of all 239 states for the optimistic capacity ceiling
frozen_inventory.reported_weighting: eigenvalue normalized within each node top-16 set
frozen_inventory.fit_weighting: uniform across all six nodes and all 16 PCs

frozen_decoder.seed_weight: exact step-zero matrix, reproducible from matched initialization and not charged as learned state
frozen_decoder.global_frames: eight learned 768x768 Rademacher frames, each stored as one bit per value and decoded with fixed 1/sqrt(768) normalization
frozen_decoder.carrier: for every node and branch, four vertically stacked orthonormal DCT-II blocks with deterministic row permutations and input/output sign flips
frozen_decoder.carrier_persistent_state: none; regenerate from node, branch, block, and seed
frozen_decoder.local_coordinates: one FP16 row-amplitude vector a_n of length 3072 and eight FP16 diagonal vectors d_nk of length 768 for each of 24 deployed layer/role nodes

optimistic_capacity_fit.targets: all 96 unit PCs: six nodes times top 16 components
optimistic_capacity_fit.temporary_coordinates: independent a and eight d vectors for each target PC; alternatives along one manifold, not simultaneous deployed state
optimistic_capacity_fit.frame_initialization: eight deterministic independent Rademacher matrices normalized by 1/sqrt(768)
optimistic_capacity_fit.frame_training: FP32 logits with signed binary deployed forward and identity straight-through derivative from the first update
optimistic_capacity_fit.local_initialization: a=1; each d deterministic Gaussian with standard deviation 1/sqrt(768)
optimistic_capacity_fit.objective: mean over all 96 targets of log(squared_cosine_capture + 1e-4)

controls.procedural_unfitted_frames: same eight initial deterministic binary frames, fixed while nuisance coordinates train for 128 updates under the identical robust objective
controls.first_two_learned_frames: zero learned branches two through seven after fitting, with no refit
controls.h51_reference: sealed two-frame int8/int4 mean weighted capture 0.09516036510467529

promotion: Only a complete H52a capacity pass authorizes discovery-only binary-frame fitting followed by chronological-late and A/B-stream transfer. It does not authorize function fitting, CE, or scale-up.
failure: Close this exact eight-plane binary robust-objective family without frame-count, bit, carrier, seed, objective, step, optimizer, layer, role, function, CE, or model-size sweep.
forbidden: calling the optimistic all-PC fit a chronological transfer result
persistent empirical PCs, DCT carrier matrices, dense residuals, or FP32 frame logits
excluding any binary code or local coordinate from checkpoint accounting
frame-count, bit, carrier, seed, objective, step, learning-rate, threshold, layer, or role sweep
function, CE, or model-size experiments before capacity and later transfer gates pass
